cl.x: Provide Sika® Injection-111 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).

Sika® Injection-111 is a highly expansive hydrophobic MDI based urethane injection grout designed to be used with an accelerator. Sika® Injection-111 reacts when it comes into contact with water to create a hydrophobic foam.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: Sika® Injection-111 may only be used by experienced professionals.
s: Stop active water flow
Stop water ingress into structures
Back grouting
Seal leaks in concrete, masonry and brickwork
Seal leaks in joints and cracks

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Mixing ratio
cl.x: Sika® Injection-111 requires the catalyst Sika® Injection-111C to create a reactive foam for injection. Typical mix ratios vary from 2-10% of the Sika® Injection-111C depending on the reaction time required, please refer to the reaction table on this PDS for the information.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Reaction time
Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Equipment
cl.x: Sika® Injection-111 is typically injected by use of a single component pump that is designed for high pressure use.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Mixing
cl.x: Sika® Injection-111 should be mixed with Sika® Injection-111C using a paddle drill mixer to create a uniform homogeneous liquid for a minimum of 20-30 seconds.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Please consult equipment/pump manufacturer for relative cleaning agent suitable for your individual equipment being used.
